Investigate correctness, SOLID, security, quality, removal guidance, and acceptance compatibility without assuming a finding.\\n'''
(bundle/'context.txt').write_text(context)
manifest={'base':base,'selector':'git diff --cached -- cleanup.py','diff':str(diff),'instructions':criteria,'intent_context':[str(bundle/'context.txt'),str(bundle/'candidate/README.md')],'evidence':items,'profile_records':[{'profile':'python','checklist':x,'triggered_by':'content: .py extension (metadata only)','conservative':False} for x in checklists],'detection_outcomes':{'python':'match cleanup.py extension','go':'no match','java':'no match','js_ts':'no match','kotlin':'no match','k8s':'no match','k8s-operator':'no match','skill-md':'no SKILL.md ancestor'},'loading_ledger':{'bootstrap':'/tmp/kk-review-instructions-uj3bghn8 parts 1-6 complete','profile':'/tmp/kk-review-instructions-h48vvlu1 part 1 complete','checklists':'/tmp/kk-review-instructions-wap8zs98 parts 1-2 complete'},'missing_evidence':'PAL tools absent; no external review possible'}
